title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — October 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.5 (Peaked October 08, 2026 at 21:17 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M6.7 (Peaked October 08, 2026 at 15:48 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 356 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Type II Radio Emission

A shock wave is moving through the Sun's atmosphere! 📻☀️🔆🌞

Solar images show a prominent bright active region and broad dark coronal areas, while the coronagraph shows streamer structure without a clear outward CME signature.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
